title: Track logical audit pressure alongside physical rows
detail: The existing warm-audit start/scheduler accepts a separate logical-position pressure port, defaulting to zero for old callers. Either1,024-physical-row or1,024-logical-position ceiling forces an attempt; it grants no comparison, lifecycle, effect or commit permission. Physical256-row/five-minute due rules and the1,000ms input quiet/foreground/clock/close rules remain. One shared logical-census helper counts newly received positions with each extent’s actual count, never a raw tag parser. Reduced-owner continuation increments only after its verified candidate is accepted, excludes the cold seed and unchanged reads, saturates scheduling pressure at its approved ceiling, and clears on owner disposal. It retains exact prefix comparisons, full baseline oracle, ciphertext checks, physical pressure including unconsumed suffixes, and erasure. contentStore/accountCapture forward that reduced pressure through the existing scheduler; no new lane. Unreduced native semantic-oracle integration remains a separately bounded next phase.
validation: Nine new controls pass. Initial before has9failures; one reduced fixture lacked its required authenticated journal era, then the repaired before exposes the missing port. Development extent field entryCount→existing count correction restores old controls without edits. The two-publisher expected count was corrected to17 from its independent8+7binary extents and two legacy tails; earlier failures remain. Controls cover independent force, unchanged physical/quiet behavior, invalid values, clock rollback, close, scheduler interruption, real mixed/multi-publisher units and genuine reduced continuation/cold-seed exclusion. Types,314focused cases across36files and18unchanged legacy pass; full327files/3193cases/one existing skip pass129.74s at240s. All old tests remain byte-exact. Quality, format,17registry checks, inventory and10controls pass. Six hashes, no domain-site/construction/obligation moves. Independent normalized AST review preserves every old default/physical/verification guard; its first broad read-only predicate normalizer was corrected to match only the exact new comparison, with the failed reviewer retained.
summary: Reduced-owner and scheduler logical pressure now forces an attempt at1,024positions independently of physical rows. Nine controls,314focused/18legacy and full327files/3193cases/one skip pass129.74s. Existing guards and old tests remain.
limitations: Unreduced native full-oracle pressure/idle integration is still open, so this does not close the complete dual audit item. No composed peer/Worker binary transaction, physical31s cold, image, activation, timing or RAM credit. G8/B, floor lifecycle, old artifacts/cold/rollback and Stage5/6 remain. No format/trust/wire/budget/gate/deadline change, commit or deployment.
decisionTitle: Keep physical storage pressure and logical audit pressure independent
decision: A compact page counts once physically and once per admitted received position logically. Observe logical work only from a verified census after candidate acceptance, excluding its cold seed. Force only an attempt at either approved ceiling; retain all comparison/interruption/native guards and the existing work lane. Continue unreduced-oracle integration separately.
next: Integrate unreduced semantic-oracle due/pressure into the existing warm-audit job with the original full comparison and native/suspension/shadow/foreground guards. Then G8/B, composed peer/Worker floor/lifecycle, old artifacts, cold and writer-off rollback proofs. Continue automatically after each freeze.
